learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and quantities from 4 to 6.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 4–6.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.

screens.label: Number 4
screens.title: 4 — four
screens.audio: This is four. Four dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Four blue dots together in one box.

choices.feedback: Look at every dot, including the one on the right.
There are four dots in this group.
Count each dot once. Check that none was counted twice.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make four dots.
screens.audio: Here is a group of four dots. To make your own, start with an empty box. Add dots, one at a time. Stop when you have four.

screens.label: Your turn
screens.title: Make 4 dots.
screens.audio: Start with an empty box. Tap Add a dot until you have four dots. You can remove a dot. Then tap Check my dots.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots in your box. Add or remove a dot, then check again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than four dots. Remove one, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than four dots. Add one, then count again.
hints: Tap Add a dot to put a dot in the box.
Point to each dot and count: one, two, three, four. Stop at four.

screens.label: Number 5
screens.title: 5 — five
screens.audio: This is five. Five dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four, five.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look at the dot on the right. Count it too.
Check that you counted each dot only once.
There are five dots in this group.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four, five.

screens.label: Your turn
screens.title: Make 5 dots.
screens.audio: Make five dots. Add them one at a time. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count your dots and try again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than five dots. Remove one, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than five dots. Add one, then count again.
hints: Touch and count each dot in your box.
One, two, three, four, five. Stop at five.

screens.label: Number 6
screens.title: 6 — six
screens.audio: This is six. Six dots. Tap the dots in order from one through six.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Six blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
Check that you did not count one dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four, five, six.

screens.title: Make 6 dots.
screens.audio: Make six dots. Add dots, then check.
screens.tooFewFeedback: You need 6 dots. Add a dot, then count again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: You need 6 dots. Remove a dot, then count again.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.

screens.title: Listen. Find the number.
hints: Tap Listen to hear the number again.

screens.title: You finished this part.
screens.body: You can take a break. Come back to practice again.
screens.audio: You finished this part. You can take a break. Come back to practice again.
